text:
Ashwin: quick smoke: running paged-Flash + fused RoPE variants to check rotary-dim sensitivity. hitting a perf cliff around seq=1920-2048, curious if others see the same :thinking:
Lina: can you paste the bench command and hardware?
Ashwin: on h100-80g, driver latest. command:
```
./bench --model=redwood/llama-13b-fused --attn=pageflash_fused_rope --rotary-dim=64 --seq-len=2048 --batch=4 --kv-hit=0.6 --profile=./out/trace.json
```
Ashwin: profile shows big stall in kernel selection path, looks like we switch from "flash_fused" -> "fallback_matmul" at a particular seq+rotary combo.
Jordan: interesting — are you forcing kv-paging? or letting runtime decide?
Ashwin: forcing paged kv for this run to isolate behaviour. if I disable paging, latency is steady but cost higher.
Sam: can you post the small flame output? even a few hotlines helps.
Ashwin: pasted top flame lines (simplified):
```
flash_fused_forward  42%
kv_page_eviction     18%
kernel_selector     12%
fallback_matmul      10%
cuda_memcpy          8%
others               10%
```
Keiko: that eviction percent looks high for a 60% hitrate. are we double-allocating page buffers somewhere?
Lina: also check rotary-dim path: we recently added a rot_dim_scaling fastpath for multiples of 32, maybe rot_dim=64 triggers an unoptimized branch?
Jordan: on a100 I saw the selection heuristic pick paged_flash only up to seq=1792 then flip. could be our cost-model threshold tuned on older kernels.
perf-bot: profiling summary for run 1768345678: avg token latency 128ms, p50 110ms, p95 210ms, kernel-switch count 3, page-evictions 420
Ashwin: thanks perf-bot. i ran a sweep rot_dim=32,48,64,80 with seq 1536/1792/2048. rot_dim=32/48 stable, 64 spikes, 80 spikes but slightly less than 64.
Sam: hypothesis: padding/alignment with rot_dim 64 causes extra workspace and forces a different kernel launch config. could be launch params crossing a threshold that favors fallback_matmul.
Keiko: would be good to capture cuLaunch configs and shared mem usage for the two kernels. also check our fused-rope kernel's precompute path for rotary stride math.
Lina: i can repro on my local rig later today. If we can get a smaller repro patch that toggles rotary-dim scaling and paging, we can add an A/B perf test to CI.
Jordan: quick mitigation: update kernel-selection cost model to prefer flash_fused when kv-page-evictions < X and seq < Y for rot_dim multiples of 16. low-risk short-term guard.
Ashwin: agreed. i can prototype a guard: if rot_dim % 16 == 0 and rot_dim <= 64 and page_evictions_rate < 0.2 then bias_cost -= 15
Sam: please add telemetry flags so we can measure the bias effect across customers (opt-in).
Keiko: also file a kernel bug to validate workspace calc for fused-rope with rot_dim=64. might be an off-by-one in padded len.
Ashwin: created TODOs:
- tweak cost model bias (PR draft) @Jordan to review
- add microbench for rot_dim alignment cases @Lina
- capture cuLaunch/shm metrics during bench @Keiko
- add A/B job to perf CI (small sample) @Sam
Ashwin: I'll push a draft PR today and attach the trace. link: https://redwood.internal/bench/1768345678/trace
Lina: thanks — if anyone hits this in prod customer incidents, tag eng-oncall and add run id.
Jordan: noting this for kernel-selection follow-up doc. moving to backlog epics: KERN-1259
Ashwin: ok i’ll update here after PR and small ci run. thanks all :thumbsup:
perf-bot: scheduled ci microbench for PR-rotary-bias in 15m.
